title: 'Liftbound' a cozy roguelite made in Claude
selftext:
I'm building Liftbound. Made with Claude Code. One Opus 5.5 Director with two to four Sonnet coders and one Haiku tester. 

Inspired by games like Balatro, Slay the Spire, and CloverPit, I wanted to create a game with additive gameplay that has you saying "just one more run", but still cozy with customizations to make each building your own. 

You plan elevator routes and get people to their floor as quickly as possible, while racking up crazy limitless multipliers. Keepsakes are the "Jokers" and modify your runs. And yes, I think it's almost as satisfying getting a large multiplier in Liftbound as it is in Balatro. ^((Maybe i'm biased))

20 story levels, with endless procedurally generated buildings to master, leaderboards, and a daily challenge thats the same for everybody with it's own leaderboard. 

And no in app purchases! Let me know what you think!
